definitions.explanation: いつ (when) + {頃|ごろ} (around, about): asks for an approximate time rather than an exact one. Often softer and more polite than a bare いつ when asking someone about their plans.

examples.japanese: いつごろ⟦{来|き}ます→来る：00254_kuru⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
いつごろ⟦{完成|かんせい}します→完成する：25528_kanseisuru⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
examples.english: Around when will it be finished?

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{建物|たてもの}→建物：01458_tatemono⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧いつごろ⟦{建|た}てられた→建てる：01189_tateru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧、⟦{誰|だれ}も→誰も：18610_daremo⟧⟦{知|し}らない→知る：00458_shiru⟧。
examples.english: Nobody knows roughly when this building was put up.

notes:
Also written いつ{頃|ごろ}. Answers name a rough time: ⟦{来月|らいげつ}→来月：00744_raigetsu⟧ごろ, ⟦{三時|さんじ}→三時：10983_sanji⟧ごろ, ⟦{夏|なつ}→夏：02236_natsu⟧ごろ.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- いつごろ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なります→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧: around when will it be? (polite, e.g. asking about a delivery)
- いつごろ⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧です⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧: since about when? (a doctor asking about symptoms)
- いつごろ⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: by around when

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦いつ→いつ：00536_itsu⟧: when; asks for the time itself, can sound blunt in requests
- {何時|なんじ}ごろ: around what o'clock; asks about the hour only
